text: Suggest likely parents in the 'contributes to' picker when creating an idea
description: Felix 2026-11-08. When the parent picker (IdeaSearchPicker via pickSupportedIdea) opens with an empty query, show ranked parent suggestions instead of nothing (today: IdeaSearchPicker.vue performSearch returns [] for an empty query). Offline eval on this graph (766 ideas with parents, leave-one-out, script in the 2026-11-08 session): plain cosine top-5 38%; parent = own vector + children centroid (as in suggest_reparents b0fb3242) + log(1+child count) prior: top-1 37%, top-3 58%, top-5 68%, top-10 78%. Expect lower with title-only text at creation time. Build: backend suggestParents(text, contextIds) embedding the new text raw (no bge query prefix, unlike searchSemantic), reusing the centroid scoring, plus a boost for the current selection and its ancestors. Local, no LLM, fast. Felix prefers explicit linking plus suggestions over slow AI calls.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude 2026-11-08 after the eval; estimated 1-2 days.
